translations.literal: To the northeast Qian'gao Mountain; Nanyang Stream issued forth.
translations.idiomatic: To the northeast stood Qian'gao Mountain; Nanyang Stream rose there.

sentences.zh: 東南雞冠山，魚頭溪出，併入景寧。

translations.literal: To the southeast Jiguan Mountain; Yutou Stream issued forth; all entered Jingning.
translations.idiomatic: To the southeast stood Jiguan Mountain; Yutou Stream rose there; all entered Jingning.

sentences.zh: 其東光石山，蓋竹溪出，合濛洲溪、交劍水，逕城北為大溪。

translations.literal: To its east Guangshi Mountain; Gaizhu Stream issued forth, joined Mengzhou Stream and Jiaojian water, passed north of the city as Da Stream.
translations.idiomatic: To its east stood Guangshi Mountain; Gaizhu Stream rose there, joined Mengzhou Stream and Jiaojian water, and passed north of the city as Da Stream.

sentences.zh: 左合竹坑溪，右合焦坑溪，逕八都鎮。

translations.literal: Left joined Zhukeng Stream; right joined Jiaokeng Stream; passed Badu Market Town.
translations.idiomatic: On the left it joined Zhukeng Stream and on the right Jiaokeng Stream and passed Badu Market Town.

sentences.zh: 右得芸洲溪，西南自福建政和入合之，是為槎溪，循棘蘭西入福建松溪。

translations.literal: Right received Yunzhou Stream, entering from the southwest at Fujian Zhenghe to join; this was Cha Stream, following Jilan west into Songxi in Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: On the right it received Yunzhou Stream, entering from Zhenghe in Fujian on the southwest to join; this was Cha Stream, following Jilan west into Songxi in Fujian.

sentences.zh: 其西北竹口溪，出雷風山，合下漈、新窯二溪併入之。

translations.literal: To its northwest Zhukou Stream issued from Leifeng Mountain, joined Xiaji and Xinyao streams and all entered it.
translations.idiomatic: To its northwest Zhukou Stream rose at Leifeng Mountain, joined Xiaji and Xinyao streams, and all entered it.

sentences.zh: 舉溪出東南棠廕山，入政和。

translations.literal: Juxi Stream issued from southeast Tangyin Mountain, entering Zhenghe.
translations.idiomatic: Juxi Stream rose at southeast Tangyin Mountain and entered Zhenghe.

translations.literal: There was a garrison post.
translations.idiomatic: A garrison post was stationed here.

translations.literal: Fushi and Daze passes.
translations.idiomatic: Fushi and Daze passes were located here.

translations.literal: Yunhe: administratively simple.
translations.idiomatic: Yunhe: administratively simple.

translations.literal: One hundred twenty li southwest of the prefectural seat.
translations.idiomatic: It lay one hundred twenty li southwest of the prefectural seat.

translations.literal: To the southeast: Mount Bailong.
translations.idiomatic: To the southeast stood Mount Bailong.

translations.literal: To the north: Mount Niutou.
translations.idiomatic: To the north stood Mount Niutou.

sentences.zh: 南：前溪山，兩山竦峙，勢險要。

translations.literal: To the south: Mount Qianxi; two mountains rose steeply; the terrain was strategically critical.
translations.idiomatic: To the south stood Mount Qianxi; two mountains rose steeply and the terrain was strategically critical.

translations.literal: To the west: Mount Yan.
translations.idiomatic: To the west stood Mount Yan.

sentences.zh: 北：石鏡岩，大溪逕其南，自龍泉入，錯出復入，右合烏椹源，左合麻、梅二洋，復錯出，自洽川口入，合洽川及硃坑、烏龍坑水，折東南，會浮雲溪。

translations.literal: To the north: Stone Mirror Cliff; Da Stream passed south of it, entering from Longquan, diverging and re-entering; right joined Wushen source; left joined Ma and Mei pools; diverged again, entering from Qiechuan mouth, joining Qiechuan and Zhukeng and Wulong pit waters; turned southeast, meeting Fuyun Stream.
translations.idiomatic: To the north stood Stone Mirror Cliff; Da Stream passed south of it, entering from Longquan, diverging and re-entering; on the right it joined Wushen source and on the left Ma and Mei pools; it diverged again, entering from Qiechuan mouth, joining Qiechuan and Zhukeng and Wulong pit waters, turned southeast, and met Fuyun Stream.

sentences.zh: 溪出西南黃棧坑，合硃源水，出利濟橋，有霧溪合新溪注之。

translations.literal: Stream issued from southwest Huangzhan Pit, joined Zhuyuan water, issued from Liji Bridge; there was Wuxi Stream joining Xin Stream to discharge into it.
translations.idiomatic: The stream rose at southwest Huangzhan Pit, joined Zhuyuan water, issued from Liji Bridge; Wuxi Stream joined Xin Stream to discharge into it.

sentences.zh: 環城而東，右合黃溪，左合雙溪，為戈溪。

translations.literal: Circled the city east; right joined Huang Stream; left joined Shuang Stream; forming Ge Stream.
translations.idiomatic: It circled the city east; on the right it joined Huang Stream and on the left Shuang Stream, forming Ge Stream.

sentences.zh: 又合諸坑水，為規溪，入麗水。

translations.literal: Also joined various pit waters, forming Gui Stream, entering Lishui.
translations.idiomatic: It also joined various pit waters, forming Gui Stream, and entered Lishui.

sentences.zh: 豐源水出西南豐源山、入景寧。

translations.literal: Fengyuan water issued from southwest Fengyuan Mountain, entering Jingning.
translations.idiomatic: Fengyuan water rose at southwest Fengyuan Mountain and entered Jingning.

translations.literal: Xuanping: administratively simple.
translations.idiomatic: Xuanping: administratively simple.

translations.literal: One hundred twenty li northwest of the prefectural seat.
translations.idiomatic: It lay one hundred twenty li northwest of the prefectural seat.

translations.literal: To the east: Mount Daishi.
translations.idiomatic: To the east stood Mount Daishi.

translations.literal: To the south: Mount Yugao.
translations.idiomatic: To the south stood Mount Yugao.

translations.literal: To the west: Zhukha Ridge.
translations.idiomatic: To the west lay Zhukha Ridge.

sentences.zh: 雙溪二源：東源分出龍樊嶺，上坦、小妃匯岡山下，曰東溪，亦曰午溪；

translations.literal: Shuang Stream had two sources: the east source divided from Longfan Ridge, above Tan and Xiaofei meeting below Gang Mountain, called East Stream, also called Wu Stream;
translations.idiomatic: Shuang Stream had two sources: the east source divided from Longfan Ridge, above Tan and Xiaofei meeting below Gang Mountain as East Stream, also called Wu Stream;

sentences.zh: 西源出礱坑山，合新錦溪，曰西溪，亦曰申溪。

translations.literal: The west source issued from Longkeng Mountain, joined Xinjin Stream, called West Stream, also called Shen Stream.
translations.idiomatic: The west source rose at Longkeng Mountain, joined Xinjin Stream, and was called West Stream, also called Shen Stream.

translations.literal: The two sources pooled at Green Rock Pool.
translations.idiomatic: The two sources pooled at Green Rock Pool.

sentences.zh: 東南流，納松陽竹□客溪，又東南，右納歐澗水，上流日溪，東自武義入合之。

translations.literal: Flowed southeast, received Songyang Zhu [text damaged]ke Stream; farther southeast, right received Oujian water; its upper reach was Ri Stream, entering from the east at Wuyi to join.
translations.idiomatic: It flowed southeast, received Songyang Zhu [text damaged]ke Stream, and farther southeast on the right received Oujian water; its upper reach was Ri Stream, entering from Wuyi on the east to join.

sentences.zh: 左合石浦水，又東南，右納松陽白石溪，入麗水為畎溪。

translations.literal: Left joined Shipu water; farther southeast, right received Songyang Baishi Stream, entering Lishui as Quan Stream.
translations.idiomatic: On the left it joined Shipu water; farther southeast on the right it received Songyang Baishi Stream and entered Lishui as Quan Stream.

sentences.zh: 北：梅溪出黃塘山，東流入武義。

translations.literal: To the north: Mei Stream issued from Huangtang Mountain, east flowing into Wuyi.
translations.idiomatic: To the north Mei Stream rose at Huangtang Mountain and flowed east into Wuyi.

sentences.zh: 汛五：曰竹□客、玉岩山、陶村、和尚田、式河頭。

translations.literal: Five garrison posts: Zhu [text damaged]ke, Yuyan Mountain, Taocun, Heshangtian, and Shihetou.
translations.idiomatic: Five garrison posts were stationed at Zhu [text damaged]ke, Yuyan Mountain, Taocun, Heshangtian, and Shihetou.

translations.literal: Jingning: administratively simple.
translations.idiomatic: Jingning: administratively simple.

translations.literal: One hundred forty li south of the prefectural seat.
translations.idiomatic: It lay one hundred forty li south of the prefectural seat.

translations.literal: To the east: Mount Luodai.
translations.idiomatic: To the east stood Mount Luodai.

translations.literal: To the southwest: Mount Zhi.
translations.idiomatic: To the southwest stood Mount Zhi.

translations.literal: To the north: Xintian Ridge.
translations.idiomatic: To the north lay Xintian Ridge.

sentences.zh: 山溪上流南洋溪，西自慶元入，左得英川，即定度溪，上流一溪西自龍泉來會，東南流，合標溪，逕新亭村，右得豐源水，西北自雲和來會，折東北，右得鶴沐溪，會塵溪入焉。

translations.literal: The upper reach of Shan Stream was Nanyang Stream; entering from the west at Qingyuan; left received Yingchuan, also called Dingdu Stream; its upper reach one stream entered from the west at Longquan to meet; flowed southeast, joined Biao Stream, passed Xinting Village; right received Fengyuan water, entering from the northwest at Yunhe to meet; turned northeast; right received Hemuy Stream; met Chen Stream entering it.
translations.idiomatic: The upper reach of Shan Stream was Nanyang Stream, entering from Qingyuan on the west; on the left it received Yingchuan, also called Dingdu Stream; its upper reach one stream entered from Longquan on the west to meet; it flowed southeast, joined Biao Stream, passed Xinting Village, received Fengyuan water on the right entering from Yunhe on the northwest to meet, turned northeast, received Hemuy Stream on the right, and met Chen Stream entering it.

sentences.zh: 又合大小順坑水，入青田為小溪。

translations.literal: Farther joined large and small Shunkeng waters, entering Qingtian as Xiao Stream.
translations.idiomatic: Farther on it joined large and small Shunkeng waters and entered Qingtian as Xiao Stream.

sentences.zh: 南白鶴溪，出梨樹嶺，下流為三插溪。

translations.literal: To the south Baihe Stream issued from Lishu Ridge; its lower reach was Sancha Stream.
translations.idiomatic: To the south Baihe Stream rose at Lishu Ridge; its lower reach was Sancha Stream.

translations.literal: There were Longshou, Longhui, and Bailu passes.
translations.idiomatic: Longshou, Longhui, and Bailu passes were located here.
